fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Run alone on macOS the test takes 2.27 s and 2.58 s, under 1 s of headroom. An unsandboxed, slot-capped local `make verify` (worktree w05-fieldmouse, log `.rebar/scratch/05f74084-win/verify2-fieldmouse.log`, Nov 20 2026, load average about 30) failed `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_gerrit_internal_webhook_does_not_need_unsupported_plugin_header` with `+++ Timeout +++ pytest-timeout expired after 3.0s` and a worker crash. CI passes it. The same three tests also expired in the 5 sandboxed runs of the same night, where the dumped main-thread stack was inside `tests/_isolation.py:_git_probe_once` called from the autouse `_no_repo_commits` fixture in `tests/conftest.py`.

## Root cause (verified)
`test_webhook_auth_rejection_is_visible_on_health`, `test_gerrit_internal_webhook_does_not_need_unsupported_plugin_header` and `test_gerrit_internal_webhook_requires_the_gerrit_service_peer` carry `@pytest.mark.timeout(3)`. The pyproject policy sets no `timeout_func_only`, so the 3 s budget covers setup and teardown too. The autouse `_no_repo_commits` fixture runs `git rev-parse HEAD` on the checkout in setup and again in teardown, each bounded by `GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (5) times `GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS` (3) in `tests/_isolation.py`. On a loaded host those two git starts alone exceed 3 s, so the marker kills the worker before the test body runs.

Deterministic reproduction (Nov 20 2026, sandboxed shell, origin/main 8e1d15e664f): a PATH `git` shim that sleeps 1.6 s before exec-ing the real git makes `pytest -m "" tests/unit/test_review_bot.py -k "webhook_auth_rejection_is_visible_on_health or gerrit_internal_webhook"` print `+++ Timeout +++` during the setup phase every run; with the shim set to 0 s the same 3 tests pass in 2.79 s.

The same defect was fixed for one test in 530b0896eee (`test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs`, 3 s to 30 s), and `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` guards only that one test by name, so its 3 siblings kept the 3 s marker.

## Approach
Fix the class, not the 3 instances: a per-test timeout marker must not be tighter than the autouse isolation guard's own bounded cost.
- In `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py`, change the three `@pytest.mark.timeout(3)` markers to `@pytest.mark.timeout(30)` with a one-line comment naming the reason (the marker wraps the autouse git probes). The tests carry no wall-clock assertion of their own to keep; their hang protection stays, at 30 s instead of 3 s.
- In `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py`, replace `test_review_bot_lifespan_marker_covers_autouse_setup` (one named test) with a whole-tree AST census: every literal `pytest.mark.timeout(N)` under `tests/` must satisfy `N >= 2 * GIT_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * GIT_PROBE_ATTEMPTS` (30 s today), importing both constants from `tests/_isolation.py` so the floor follows the guard if the guard changes. The failure message names each offending file, line and value.
- No product code, config key, environment variable or flag changes.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py`
- `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py`

## Testing
- Before the change, the new census test fails naming the 3 review-bot markers (run recorded on this ticket); after, it passes.
- Under the 1.6 s git shim the 3 review-bot tests pass after the change (run recorded here); with no shim they still pass.
- Edge: the census reads both decorator markers and `pytestmark = pytest.mark.timeout(N)` assignments, and ignores non-literal arguments.
- `make verify` through the shared verify slot passes on the change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No literal `pytest.mark.timeout(N)` under `tests/` is below the autouse git-probe bound, enforced by a census test in `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` that derives its floor from `tests/_isolation.py`.
- [x] The 3 review-bot webhook tests pass under the 1.6 s-per-start git shim, with the run recorded on this ticket.
- [x] `make verify` passes on the change, and Gerrit gives Verified +1. (Slot run: 21538 passed, 0 timeouts; its 3 errors were a stray scratch file written into the worktree root by this session, recorded in a comment; integration tier 226 passed; Gerrit 3488 Verified +1, merged as 15b9bddac46.)
